notes: Each test case simulates a realistic coding task to validate docs-context skill behavior.
Fixtures (files/) represent starting project state; the eval runner should copy them into the agent's workspace before each run.
The agent under test has access to Read/Write/Edit/Bash/Glob/Grep tools and the docs-context skill.
Observable signals per run: (1) transcript (Skill invocations, tool calls, replies); (2) filesystem diff of docs/; (3) sync summary text if written.
Run each test twice: with docs-context skill available / without it. Compare pass rates and token cost.
Priority 1 (P1) tests cover the highest-risk, highest-signal behaviors: net-delta auto-trigger, reverse rollback sync, no-op on design, slug-confirmation, multi-module Upstream/Downstream sync.

Schema note (v1.2): docs/modules.md is now docs/modules/<business>.md (one file per business module, internally split by '## Capability:' sections). docs/decisions.md is now docs/decisions/ADR-<slug>.md (one file per decision; old decisions deleted, not marked Superseded). No README/index files under either directory.

evals.prompt: Add a discount_rate field to the Order entity. Make it a Double, nullable, default 0.0.
evals.expected_output: Before generating the field declaration, the agent reads docs/coding.md, recognizes that Double for rate fields is prohibited (coding.md mandates Long basis points), and proactively alerts the user about the conflict. The agent either asks the user to confirm the override OR proposes the compliant alternative (Long basis points). The agent does NOT silently generate the Double-typed field.
evals.setup_note: Fixture: fixture-synced-pay variant where docs/coding.md explicitly forbids Double/BigDecimal for amount and rate fields and mandates Long with basis points. Tests the post-load behavior 'proactively alert on constraint violations' — a marquee feature claimed in README.
assertions: The agent's transcript shows docs/coding.md being read before any code generation.

The agent's reply explicitly mentions the conflict between the user's request (Double) and the coding standard (Long basis points). Look for keywords like 'coding.md', 'forbidden', 'prohibited', 'basis points', or 'Long'.
The agent did NOT silently write a Double-typed discount_rate field to source code.

The final outcome is one of: (a) the agent asked the user to confirm overriding coding.md, OR (b) the agent generated the compliant Long-typed version, OR (c) the agent stopped and waited for clarification — NOT silent violation.

The new ADR file has yaml frontmatter with at least: title, date, proposer fields populated.
The new ADR file has at minimum these sections: '## Background', '## Alternatives Considered', '## Decision', '## Consequences'.
The new ADR's Decision section names Stripe as the chosen option.
Neither the new ADR nor any other file in docs/decisions/ contains 'Superseded' or 'Deprecated' status text.
The Doc Sync Summary lists both: deletion of the old ADR AND creation of the new ADR.

fixtures_needed.name: fixture-synced-pay-with-adr
fixtures_needed.description: Same as fixture-synced-pay, plus docs/decisions/ADR-payment-gateway-selection.md (Adyen chosen, frontmatter populated, no Superseded state).
fixtures_needed.purpose: Used for ADR de-duplication test (eval 14) and full replace flow test (eval 17).

fixtures_needed.name: fixture-pay-with-coding-constraint
fixtures_needed.description: Same as fixture-synced-pay, but docs/coding.md is augmented with an explicit rule: 'Amount and rate fields MUST use Long type (basis points or cents). Double and BigDecimal are PROHIBITED for monetary or rate values.' src/ contains an Order entity with no discount/rate fields yet.
fixtures_needed.purpose: Used for constraint-violation-alert test (eval 16). The seeded coding.md rule must be unambiguous so the agent can clearly recognize the conflict when asked to use Double.

fixtures_needed.name: fixture-priority-conflict
fixtures_needed.description: A loan-service fixture. docs/coding.md mandates 'rate fields use Long basis points'. docs/modules/loan.md exists with an 'Issue Loan' Capability whose Implementation incorrectly notes 'rate stored as BigDecimal' (this inconsistency is intentional). src/ contains a Loan entity without an interest_rate field. docs/decisions/ is empty.
fixtures_needed.purpose: Used for priority-chain-conflict test (eval 18). Tests that the agent applies the document priority chain (coding.md > modules/*) when docs disagree, AND surfaces the inconsistency for cleanup.

fixtures_needed.name: fixture-synced-pay-with-status
fixtures_needed.description: Same as fixture-synced-pay, plus the Order entity in src/ ALREADY has a `status` field (with a small enum: PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED) AND docs/modules/pay.md ALREADY documents the status field under the relevant Capability's '### Implementation' subsection (and any related state transitions). Represents the post-sync state from a 'previous session' that the user now wants to roll back.
fixtures_needed.purpose: Used for cross-session reverse-sync test (eval 22). The fixture must look like docs and code are already in sync regarding status; the test then verifies the agent reverse-syncs docs when the user asks to remove status.

fixture_setup_instructions.how_to_create: Fixtures can be assembled as minimal Java/Go/Node projects. Suggested: copy a small real subproject, strip to 10-20 files, seed docs/ per templates in skills/docs-context/assets/templates/. For module files, follow the Capability-based template (assets/templates/module.md). For ADRs, follow the minimal-frontmatter template (assets/templates/decision.md). Do NOT create README files under docs/modules/ or docs/decisions/.
